question: Round 1, one fault at a time: does the SPY 50-day filter screen out the risk that actually hurt us (momentum reversing), and is the picker paying for over-weighting RS, the most extended names and the leading sectors?

variants.name: p_cap98
variants.why: drop RS 99 (worst 20-day outcome in live candidate data)

variants.name: p_ext3
variants.why: no entry more than 3 ATRs above the 20-day EMA

variants.name: f_spy2_mom_loose
variants.why: momentum health, block only a clear reversal (leaders 2 pts behind)

variants.name: f_spy2_mom
variants.why: keep SPY 2% and add momentum health

variants.name: p_nosector
variants.why: no leader-sector boost (leaders did worse in live candidate data)

variants.name: c_picker_plus_mom
variants.why: picker fixes plus momentum health in place of SPY

variants.name: f_mom_only
variants.why: replace the SPY filter with a momentum-health filter: buy only while last month's leaders beat the median

variants.name: f_breadth50
variants.why: replace SPY with breadth: half the market above its 50-day

variants.name: f_spy_off
variants.why: baseline: no market filter at all
